question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a gold present, Bob has a white present, Claire has a silver present, Dave has a teal present, Eve has a red present, Fred has a orange present, and Gertrude has a black present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Alice and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Fred swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Eve has the
Options:
(A) gold present
(B) white present
(C) silver present
(D) teal present
(E) red present
(F) orange present
(G) black present
solution:
Gift colors in fixed order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: gold | white | silver | teal | red | orange | black
1. Alice ↔ Eve: red | white | silver | teal | gold | orange | black
2. Fred ↔ Bob: red | orange | silver | teal | gold | white | black
3. Fred ↔ Eve: red | orange | silver | teal | white | gold | black
4. Claire ↔ Bob: red | silver | orange | teal | white | gold | black
5. Dave ↔ Eve: red | silver | orange | white | teal | gold | black
6. Alice ↔ Fred: gold | silver | orange | white | teal | red | black
7. Alice ↔ Bob: silver | gold | orange | white | teal | red | black
Eve has the teal present, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
